*   **Strengths:** Meets the sub-frame latency target (< 10 ms p95) [S1, unofficial].

The claim states that the system meets the sub-frame latency target (< 10 ms p95) and cites source [S1]. The evidence confirms that the p95 latency is 5.30 ms, which is indeed under 10 ms. However, the evidence also explicitly notes 'Partial success' because 'not all cursor positions yield a unique splat hit' (only 49 out of 200 samples produced a unique-splat hit). The claim implies a successful meeting of the target without qualification, whereas the evidence indicates that while the latency metric was met, the functional reliability (unique splat identification) was incomplete. Therefore, the evidence supports the latency fact but contradicts the implication of full functional success, resulting in a partial verdict.
